AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

20. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

21. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Domestic Hygiene.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Fuel Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Wild Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
